title: To have done, having done
summary: Dạng hoàn thành không chia: to have + V3 (sau seem, appear, would like, be said) và having + V3 (sau giới từ, deny, regret) cho việc xảy ra trước.

dialogue.en: The new manager [[seems to have made]] a good start.
dialogue.vi: Quản lý mới có vẻ đã khởi đầu tốt.

dialogue.en: Yes. She's said [[to have worked]] in Singapore for years.
dialogue.vi: Ừ. Nghe nói chị ấy từng làm ở Singapore nhiều năm.

dialogue.en: I'd like [[to have met]] her before she started.
dialogue.vi: Giá mà mình gặp chị ấy trước khi chị ấy bắt đầu.

dialogue.en: She doesn't regret [[having left]] her old job, she says.
dialogue.vi: Chị ấy bảo không hối tiếc vì đã bỏ việc cũ.
Xem kế hoạch của chị ấy rồi, mình thấy ấn tượng.

dialogue.en: Me too. She [[appears to have thought]] of everything.
dialogue.vi: Mình cũng vậy. Chị ấy có vẻ đã tính hết mọi thứ.

sections.heading: Seem / appear / be said + to have + V3
sections.rule: **to have + V3** nói việc **đã xảy ra trước** thời điểm của động từ chính: seem, appear, be said, be thought, be believed.

examples.en: He [[seems to have forgotten]] the meeting.
examples.vi: Có vẻ anh ấy đã quên cuộc họp.

examples.en: The fire [[is thought to have started]] at night.
examples.vi: Người ta cho rằng lửa bắt đầu từ ban đêm.
examples.why: Bị động tường thuật + to have V3.

examples.vi: Có vẻ cô ấy đã về sớm.

check.prompt: The thieves seem ___ through the window.
check.explain: Việc đã xảy ra trước → to have entered.

sections.heading: Would like / would love + to have + V3
sections.rule: **would like / would love / would hate + to have + V3** = ước gì đã (nhưng không được).

examples.en: I'd [[like to have seen]] the show.
examples.vi: Giá mà tôi được xem buổi diễn.

examples.en: She would [[love to have studied]] abroad.
examples.vi: Cô ấy rất muốn được du học (nhưng không thể).

check.prompt: I'd love ___ your face when you heard the news!
check.explain: Tiếc điều đã qua → to have seen.

sections.heading: Having + V3 sau giới từ và deny, regret, admit
sections.rule: **having + V3** nhấn việc **đã xong trước**, dùng sau giới từ và các động từ + V-ing như deny, regret, admit, remember.

examples.vi: Anh ấy chối đã lấy tiền.

examples.en: She was praised for [[having finished]] early.
examples.vi: Cô ấy được khen vì đã làm xong sớm.
Tôi hối hận vì đã nói vậy.

check.prompt: He admitted ___ the car without asking.

mistakes.wrong: He seems to forget the meeting yesterday.
mistakes.right: He seems to have forgotten the meeting yesterday.
mistakes.why: Việc trong quá khứ → to have + V3.

mistakes.wrong: She is said to have went abroad.
mistakes.right: She is said to have gone abroad.

mistakes.wrong: I'd like to have see that film.
mistakes.right: I'd like to have seen that film.

mistakes.wrong: He denied to have stolen it.
Having finish the work, we left.
mistakes.right: Having finished the work, we left.

exercises.prompt: The museum is believed ___ in the 1920s.
exercises.explain: Bị động, việc quá khứ → to have been built.

exercises.prompt: You seem ___ a lot of weight.
exercises.explain: Việc đã xảy ra → to have lost.

exercises.prompt: I'd like ___ to the party, but I was ill.
exercises.explain: Tiếc điều đã qua → to have gone.

exercises.prompt: Câu nào nói việc ĐÃ xảy ra?
options: He seems to know the answer.
He seems to have known the answer.
exercises.explain: To have known: trước thời điểm nói.

exercises.prompt: The suspect is thought ___ the country.
answers: to have left
exercises.explain: Việc đã xảy ra → to have + V3.

answers: having been
being
exercises.explain: Sau giới từ: having been / being.

answers: to have met
having locked
locking

exercises.vi: Có vẻ anh ấy đã quên.
Cô ấy chối đã nói dối.

exercises.sentence: The plane is believed to crash into the sea.
answers: The plane is believed to have crashed into the sea.
exercises.explain: Việc đã xảy ra → to have crashed.

exercises.sentence: She denied to have broken the vase.
answers: She denied having broken the vase.

exercises.sentence: I'd love to have went with you.
answers: I'd love to have gone with you.

exercises.vi: Có vẻ họ đã cãi nhau.
answers: They seem to have argued.
They seem to have had an argument.
They seem to have quarreled.
They appear to have argued.
They appear to have had an argument.
It seems that they have argued.

exercises.vi: Tôi hối hận vì đã không học tiếng Anh sớm hơn.
answers: I regret not having learned English earlier.
I regret not having studied English earlier.
I regret not learning English earlier.
I regret not studying English earlier.
I regret not having learnt English earlier.
I regret that I didn't learn English earlier.
